title: Sunita Sharma v. Pankaj Sharma
text: The wife filed a matrimonial appeal challenging dismissal of her divorce petition under Section 13 HMA. The ground pleaded was cruelty. The trial court dismissed the petition holding that occasional quarrels do not amount to cruelty. This court, on reappraisal of evidence, finds that the husband's conduct went beyond ordinary domestic discord. He forced the wife to give up employment, restricted her movements, and subjected her to sustained mental and emotional abuse. The standard of cruelty under Section 13 HMA does not require physical violence. The cumulative effect of the husband's conduct amounts to cruelty making it unreasonable to expect the wife to live with him. The marriage has irretrievably broken down. The appeal is allowed. Divorce is granted on the ground of cruelty under Section 13 HMA. Permanent alimony of Rs 30,00,000 is awarded to the wife. The wife also gets custody of the children.
